subject: [PATCH 26/60] mm/migrate: leave pages outside common memory in move_pages()

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new condition to leave pages outside common memory where they are, similar to ZONE_DEVICE pages. This change affects how status queries report node information for these pages.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series modifies the move_pages() function to leave pages outside common memory in their current location, similar to ZONE_DEVICE pages. The change affects how status queries report node information for these pages.
